channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Video: Israeli strike kills newlywed woman in south Lebanon
item.description: A Lebanese woman has been killed, and several other people injured by Israeli strikes on Nabatieh, southern Lebanon.

item.title: Three killed in strikes on Gaza as Israel renews threats over kite-flying
item.description: Israeli defence minister renews threat to expel Palestinians from areas where kites or balloons are being flown in Gaza.

item.title: Russian military serviceman killed in St Petersburg car blast
item.description: This is the latest in a series of blasts targeting military personnel and others linked to Russia's war on Ukraine.

item.title: Iran, Qatar hold Hormuz talks amid int’l hopes dialogue with US will resume
item.description: Officials review efforts being made to reduce war escalation and create 'appropriate conditions' for dialogue, Doha says

item.title: Israeli strike kills ‘newlywed’ woman in south Lebanon, wounds others
item.description: Violence has eased since the US-Iran MoU and Israel-Lebanon framework, but Beirut still reports strikes and demolitions.

item.title: Board of Peace's Gaza envoy criticises Israeli strikes and Hamas actions
item.description: Nickolay Mladenov warns that a collapse of last October's ceasefire would be "a point of no return" for the region.

item.title: Two killed in 'domestic violence incident' at school near Berlin
item.description: Police have arrested a 19-year-old male suspect after an incident in which two people were killed near the German capital.

item.title: Jellyfish force partial shutdown of French nuclear plant
item.description: It is the second consecutive year that jellyfish has forced the closure of the Gravelines power station in northern France.

item.title: People pulled from mud in Nepal after deadly flash floods
item.description: At least 160 people have been killed along the Nepal-Tibet border as rescuers struggle to reach the disaster zone.
